newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks recoup, close sharply up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks recoup, close sharply up.

text.p: Pakistani stocks recouped and closed sharply up on Friday on buying of blue chips by long-term investors, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
The index was pushed up by sharp rises in the blue chips, which are likely to post fresh gains when the market reopens after the Saturday-Sunday weekend, one dealer said.

The KSE 100-share index closed 14.31 points, or 0.82 percent, up at 1,759.66 amid 157 losers and 71 gainers at 12.20 p.m. (0720 GMT). Lever Bros rose 25 rupees to 875 and PSO 10 to 380. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
